speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry what are the plans for the fauna and flora of Jurong Bird Park upon its closure after 3 January 2023.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: JTC is working with Mandai Wildlife Group and the relevant agencies on the reinstatement of the site after Jurong Bird Park moves to Mandai.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
text: Dover Forest was 33 hectares, Jurong Bird Park is 20 hectares.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
text: First, what is the determined annual economic potential of the land of Jurong Bird Park —

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Mr Shawn Huang, if you could just keep to two supplementary questions.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: So, the economic potential that could be derived from its development.
